annotations.title: Publish video assets to the Workshop

description: Publish video-studio assets (from generate_asset or written by hand) into the Workshop of ONE app as the app's official content: its players find them in the studio's asset feed and use them in their videos. One asset becomes a video.asset publication, several — a video.pack. The cover is the asset's own picture (cut-out, prop, scene background) or thumbnail_url — a picture you generated with this account's credits (png/jpeg/webp up to 1 MB); heroes and music need thumbnail_url. Free by default; `access` takes the Workshop access options of the app (e.g. a price in its currency). Needs config:write on the app. Check the assets with validate_asset of @idosgames/mcp first: the studio drops an invalid asset when it opens the pack.

access.description: Workshop access options as the app defines them, e.g. [{"Mode":"Free"}] (default) or a price.

assets.description: The assets (the `asset` of generate_asset, or package.assets). 1–40.

thumbnail_url.description: Cover: the https address of a picture generated by this account (optional for pictures, required for heroes and music).

title.description: Name of the publication in the Workshop (default — the first asset's title).

title_id.description: The app (with the video studio) whose Workshop gets the assets.
